column2: Can the track buttons of the video editor be small, medium or large?
column3: Yes: in the video editor, Display → “Track buttons: small” or “large” (“default size” = medium, as before); or Settings → “Editing, retouching, layout and sound” → 🎬 Video editor layout → the “Small”, “Medium (default)” and “Large” buttons under “Track button size”. It is kept straight away, with “↶ Undo” in the message.

column2: How do I make a clip’s sound rise or fall over time in the video editor?
column3: Choose the clip (video, overlay or sound), 🎯 Item tab → “📈 Volume over time”: set the fade-in and fade-out, then “✎ Place points on the clip”. On the clip, in the timeline: a click places a point (at the top: louder, up to twice as loud; in the middle: the set volume; at the bottom: silence), drag a point to move it, a double-click removes it. “＋ Point at the playhead” places one where you are; “✕ Clear the curve” removes them all (with “↶ Undo”). The curve is used for the preview, the exported video and the standard volume (LUFS).

column2: What effects can I put on the sound of a clip in the video editor?
column3: 🎯 Item tab → “🔊 Sound of this clip” (or the 🔊 Sound tab for the whole film): clearer voice, less hiss, bass, treble, mono, “🗜 More even volume” (quiet passages come up, loud ones go down), “⛪ Reverb” (a room, a large hall, a church, a cellar) and “↔ Left ↔ right”. These are the same effects as in 🎧 Sound and the 🎚️ Sound studio (a single engine). “↺ Reset to default” removes them; there is also one for the colours of a clip, the colours of the whole film and the sound of the whole film, with “↶ Undo” in the message.

column2: How do I arrange the settings of the video editor’s right panel?
column3: Each tab (🎯 Item, 🎨 Colours, 🔊 Sound, 🎞️ Film) is made of sections that you fold or open with a click on their title. To change their order: drag the ⠿ handle in front of the title, or go onto it (Tab) and press Alt + ↑ / ↓. The order (for a video, an overlay, a text or a sound) and the open or closed sections are kept for next time. Display → “Right panel sections: ↺ Reset to default” puts everything back as before.

column2: Can I put an outline, a shadow or a band on the titles of the video editor?
column3: Yes: choose the title, 🎯 Item tab. “🔤 Font and colour”: font (from the app or the computer), colour, bold, italic, shadow, band, fade. “✒️ Outline and shadow”: a coloured outline around the letters and its thickness, the colour and strength of the shadow. “▭ Band behind the text”: its opacity and rounded corners. “✨ Movement”: the entrance (fade, slide, typewriter…), the movement during and the exit; “📐 Duration, size and position”: the alignment and position. Everything looks the same in the exported video.

column2: The 🐞 button at the top right and the “Something didn’t work” banner
column3: The 🐞 “Report a bug” button, at the top right, opens the same “🐞 Report a problem” window (you arrange or hide it in Settings → Appearance → “Top-right buttons”). When the app runs into a real error, a small banner also appears at the bottom right: “🐞 Something didn’t work. Do you want to report it?”. “Report” opens the window, already filled in with the screen and the error (with nothing from your family tree): all you have left to do is say what you were doing just before; × closes it. It comes back at most once per screen and per minute, never in simple mode, and sits above the languages banner if it is there. To stop seeing it: Settings → “🔄 Updates” → “Offer to report when something doesn’t work”. Nothing is sent without you.

column2: Which language does the app open in the very first time?
column3: In your computer’s language, if the app knows it (for example in German on a computer set to German); otherwise in English, and in French on a computer set to French. On this first screen, the “🌐” menu lists every language, and two buttons “🇫🇷 Français” and “🇬🇧 English” switch with one click. Your choice is kept afterwards. A genealogy you have already started never changes language on its own.
